news.title: SHRM’s insurance carrier says it’s not on the hook for $10M jury verdict
news.summary: The insurer sued SHRM Tuesday, alleging state law prohibits it from indemnifying the organization because the jury found intentional race discrimination.

news.title: Northwestern Mutual must fork over DEI data in EEOC probe of alleged failure to promote White worker
news.summary: The company unsuccessfully claimed that the agency’s information requests were overbroad and too indefinite, according to a Wisconsin federal judge.

news.title: AI use may improve engagement, but only under the right conditions
news.summary: Manager support is the key to developing enthusiastic support for artificial intelligence tools in the workplace, according to research from Gallup.

news.title: HR often uses ChatGPT to complete non-HR tasks, according to OpenAI report
news.summary: AI can change the division of work within an organization by allowing users to perform tasks outside their typical roles, OpenAI said.

news.title: Pulling back from DEI increases legal risk — and costs organizations qualified women
news.summary: Gender equity researcher Amy Diehl offers eight pillars for HR to keep in mind regarding diversity and inclusion at work.

news.title: Jury awards male surgical technician $105K for delivery room discrimination
news.summary: According to the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, two female obstetricians barred the technician from performing his job because of his sex.

news.title: Fintech company violated NLRA when it fired worker for LinkedIn post, judge finds
news.summary: The worker posted on LinkedIn that Apex Fintech Solutions “allowed outright hate to proliferate as a demonstration of what they think DEI is.”

news.title: Why manager training may be the key to AI integration
news.summary: Without effective managers, companies may have a hard time seeing the gains that they expect from AI investments.

news.title: Managers say they don’t feel ready to lead an AI-fluent workforce
news.summary: Many companies aren’t providing the necessary training to help employees learn how to use artificial intelligence, per Indeed research.

news.title: How to make sure front-line managers are heard
news.summary: Despite knowing how important front-line managers are, employers often ignore their feedback, a study showed.
